notes.title: The Cave: Exploration Mechanics, Enemies, and the Future of Early Access!
notes.notes: [p]The journey in Revella is about to get deeper—literally. The upcoming Demo update invites you to explore the new Cave, a place full of secrets, challenges, and rewards. In addition, we've introduced a new exploration mechanic that changes the way you interact with the world and discover its mysteries. Discover new powers, enemies, complete new missions, and meet [b]Mr. Chomp[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/43d0d1c9f8dcc2a2464bb484b320123e81b62e72.png"][/img][/p][p]"CHOOOOOMP!" - Said Mr. Chomp.[/p][p][/p][p]This is one of the last major updates to the Demo before the official Early Access launch. As we enter this phase, we will be committed to active development, constantly adding content and listening closely to the community. Our game has an active crowdfunding campaign, but so far, I have not received any financial compensation for it, so I am committing to leaving the game in Early Access so that more people can participate in the future of Revella.[/p][p][/p][p]💬 [b]Join our Discord — there you can:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Give direct feedback that influences the direction of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Vote on what should or should not be added to Revella.[/p][/*][*][p]Interact with other explorers and share discoveries.[/p][/*][*][p]Enter the giveaway for a free Revella key![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🔗 [url="https://discord.gg/ByqgpY3E7u"]Join now and be part of this adventure from the beginning![/url][/p][p][/p][p]The future of Revella is in your hands. Get ready to explore, vote, influence... and survive.[/p]

notes.title: We've reached Version 0.1.4!
notes.notes: [h1]Your feedback[/h1][p]We are currently at [b]version 0.1.4[/b], and thanks to some feedback from the[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3703150/discussions/"] Steam community discussion[/url], I saw that some people were having difficulties and getting stuck when trying to find the two fragments in the cat mission. The intention of this part is not to be difficult, nor to instigate an investigative puzzle (not at the moment). So I fixed the problem, making it much more accessible for everyone. Someone contacted me about the use of controls, and [b]at the moment[/b] I am unable to provide that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/172298c120fc3c065d5e43d4b780ace8776fb232.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]CRT effect and shadows![/h2][p]If you notice, in previous versions, the CRT effect did not exist. I am adding this as something new to the game, and I hope the community will tell me what they think. Let me know in the comments or on our \[[url="https://discord.gg/ByqgpY3E7u"]Discord server[/url]]. Also, while playing Earthbound recently, I noticed the way they create shadows, so I decided to implement it in Revella, and I would like to know if you are satisfied with the new look![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/c3ef669f527402246e1073748c97ab2072c831d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Achievements and Map Update[/h2][p]The village map has been completely redesigned, and now you can access a new area that was not previously accessible. In addition, two more [strike](secret)[/strike] achievements have been added, which will be extremely important for the final game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610895/63f9ec3047df054a1ff61ad0d32324abea776e6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Acknowledgments and the future[/h3][p]I would like to express my immense gratitude for the publicity that many of you are providing through YouTube and X. This is truly incredible and something I was not expecting to happen! As a result, we have reached the milestone of 1,000 wishlists from April to August! I will soon be updating the game with the new chapter of the Demo, and I hope everyone likes the mechanics that will be added to the game![/p][p][/p][p]I sincerely thank everyone who is part of the Revella community![/p]

notes.title: WE'VE REACHED 600 WISHLISTS!
notes.notes: [p]I'm delighted to announce that Revella has reached the 600 wishlist mark at the Steam Next Fest event! This milestone is very important to me as the game started without any financial incentive and without receiving anything in the crowdfunding campaign so far. This means that the efforts I'm putting into the game are being seen and are being rewarded with the feedback I've been receiving these days![/p][p][/p][h2]Revella's future[/h2][p]Revella's demo is currently on over a thousand Steam accounts, and that's a very important mark for a first project by an Indie developer! As a result, I've received some feedback and I'm here to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][h3]General adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Some sprites and tilesets will soon undergo improvements to their design, borders and lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Items in the inventory will have graphics (sprites), different from the current model.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to gameplay gathered from player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New content[/h3][list][*][p][b]New area:[/b] The Cave, coming this July.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New area:[/b] Forest, coming this August.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Each area will have different enemies, NPCs, allies, secrets and mysteries, and they will be different chapters[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who is playing, building and sending feedback on the Revella universe.[/p]

notes.title: Revella at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p]From June 9th to June 16th, Revella is taking part in Steam Next Fest. And that means it's your chance to add the game to your wishlist and jump into an enhanced version of our Demo![/p][p]This updated demo brings gameplay improvements, and a deeper look into the dark mysteries of Revella’s world. If you’ve already played it, now’s the time to come back and feel the difference. If it’s your first time… welcome to a cursed land full of secrets, danger, and choices that matter.[/p][p]Let the village pull you in — meet key characters, uncover hidden paths, and get a taste of what’s to come in the full game. Your journey starts now.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703150/Revella/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Don't miss it — the shadows won’t wait.[/p]

notes.title: QOL and Bugs Update 0.1.3.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Based on initial feedback, I've improved some things related to the speed of battle, slowing down the text so that damage and actions can be visualized more concretely.
[*] The menu has also been completely changed with fullscreen options and a NEW feature! The controls to be used in WASD, because first-person shooter (FPS) players should feel right at home, shouldn't they?
[*] The menu screen has been changed to a more up-to-date version.
[*] Correction of texts that were not written correctly.
[/list]

[h2]What can you expect in the next updates?[/h2]
We're still focusing on listening to player feedback, improvements to battles and sprites are on the way! Also, with a new area to explore soon (The Caves).

Be sure to add the game to your Steam wishlist!

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=o0d_bkSrQ_M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Revella Demo 0.1.2 is officially available![/h1]
You can now experience all the new features of Revella and the world of Aveline here on Steam!

[h2]What's in Demo 0.1.2?[/h2]
The current version brings several changes to the internal and external scenery of the world of Revella, such as the alternation between day and night, with graphical adjustments in pixel art depending on the time of day. Additionally, parts of the game have been reworked with a new script and storyline. Secrets have been added to the game to unlock new ways to connect with the world of Revella (there will be many more secrets to discover as updates are released).

New NPCs have been added and an alternate costume for Aveline has also been created. You just need to know how to get it! Alternatively, on the Steam version, we will bring the achievement "The End?", representing the completion of the first part of the Demo. With this, the Demo will bring 2 future achievements, representing the end of Chapter 1 and the end of Chapter 2, where the Demo will officially end.

With all these new features, it is normal that there will be some bugs, including visual ones, so I encourage you to join our server on [[url=https://discord.gg/SUpc9rVxJR]DISCORD[/url]] and update with bug reports, as well as feedback on the game. I will be actively listening to the community to bring you the experience that Revella should have when it officially launches.
